title: post-implementation-chain
description: Ordered stages executed after a typed implementer agent completes. Hooks in viv-hooks consume this to enforce the chain.

agent_type_pattern.description: Regex matched against the dispatched agent's name. Chain runs after agents matching this pattern complete.

dispatch_constraints.description: Optional pre-dispatch constraints. Future rules that prescribe fan-out (none currently) MUST set max_batch_size_ref so the cap is honored declaratively. See ttl-batch-sizing-policy.schema.json and the 2026-05-22 audit in architecture/audits/.

max_batch_size_ref.description: Reference to a ttl-batch-sizing-policy by id (e.g. "ttl-batch-sizing-policy/default"). The consumer hook/orchestrator MUST cap dispatch N at floor(ceiling.empirical_value * safety_margin) of the referenced policy.

max_batch_size_override.description: Explicit numeric override. MUST NOT exceed the cap derived from the referenced policy. If set without max_batch_size_ref, the consumer rejects the rule.

override_justification.description: Required when max_batch_size_override is set. Free-form prose explaining why the override is safe.

kind.description: Stage classification. Hooks can dispatch the right consumer based on kind.

required.description: If false, stage is conditional (see condition).

agent.description: Specific agent to dispatch for this stage. Null if dispatch resolves dynamically (e.g. domain-review uses routing-table).
